fusions.name: Underfoot Scratch
fusions.desc: A quick scratch that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds. For 2 seconds after you use it, you move 10% faster.

fusions.name: Pounce From Cover
fusions.desc: A pounce that deals 18 damage, then consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.6 times their remaining damage to this blow. It only strikes a target at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Burrow In
fusions.desc: Veils you for 8 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, you move 20% faster while veiled, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Dusk Den
fusions.desc: At night, your armour is 12% higher.
